warning.infectedCopies: Infected versions of the Genshin Stella Mod software are circulating online. Make sure you download Stella Mod only from a TRUSTED SOURCE, such as [sefinek.net](https://stella.sefinek.net).
warning.unofficialSources: Never download Stella Mod from unofficial websites, as they may contain malware, often in the form of cryptocurrency miners. Always verify the authenticity of the source before downloading.
warning.loginSafety: If anyone asks for your Genshin Impact login details under the pretext of helping with Stella Mod, block them immediately. The Stella Mod developer will NEVER ask for your passwords or any other sensitive information.

verification.title: How to verify a download
steps: Download Stella Mod only from the official website or GitHub Releases.
After downloading, calculate the SHA-256 or SHA-512 checksum of the installer file.
Compare the result with the value listed below before running the file.
If a link or file looks suspicious, do not open it. Report it on our Discord server.
